decide.sql: SELECT thinkthen_decide('Is this a complaint?', 'i want a refund now');

choose.sql: SELECT thinkthen_choose('{"choose":"Which team handles this?","options":["the refund desk","other desk"]}', 'refund now');

score.sql: SELECT thinkthen_score('{"score":"How strong is the refund claim?","levels":["low","mid","high"]}', 'maybe later');

tag.sql: SELECT thinkthen_tag('{"tag":"What is in this text?","labels":["refund","shipping"]}', 'the refund and the shipping');

details.sql: SELECT json_array_length(thinkthen_details('Is this a complaint?', 'i want a refund now'), '$.requests');

warm.sql: SELECT thinkthen_warm('Is this a complaint?', t) FROM (SELECT 'refund now' AS t UNION ALL SELECT 'refund again');

recognize.sql: SELECT text, kind FROM thinkthen_recognize('Maria Chen joined Northwind Freight in Chicago last spring.', 'person,organization,place');

setup: CREATE TABLE alerts(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT)

INSERT INTO alerts VALUES (1,'Checkout returns 500 at the payment step.'),(2,'Card charges are failing for every customer.'),(3,'The nightly export ran two hours late.'),(4,'The payments database ran out of disk space.')
relate.sql: SELECT name, source, target, probability FROM thinkthen_relate('alerts','id','body','caused_by');
